events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, the legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off in Bethel, New York, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: 57 years ago, a field in New York became the epicentre of a cultural revolution. From Jimi Hendrix to Janis Joplin, Woodstock wasn't just a festival, it was a moment that defined a generation. What's your favourite memory or track from the iconic three days of peace and music?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977. He would have been 91.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost him, and Elvis Presley's impact on music is still undeniable. The King would have been 91 today. What's the one Elvis track that always gets you all shook up?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of Tupac Shakur's passing. His voice and lyrics continue to resonate, and he would have been 55 this year. What's your go-to track from the rap icon?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years ago, the world lost a true guitar visionary. Jimi Hendrix would have been 84 this year, and his innovative sound still inspires. Which Hendrix track showcases his genius best for you?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: The album that gave us THAT zebra crossing photo! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' is 57 years old. Which track from this legendary record is always on your playlist?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman is still rocking. What's your favourite track from her incredible career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It!
angles.copy: Our kid's another year older! Liam Gallagher is 54 today. Whether it's Oasis classics or his solo bangers, what's your favourite tune from the Manchester icon? As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released in the US in October 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine' a better world. The timeless message of this song still resonates today. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit screens, the world's favourite secret agent is still captivating audiences. What's your top Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of legendary Beatles co-founder and peace activist John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's the one Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles gave us the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. A double album packed with incredible tracks. Which one's your favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: A True Champion
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. The Queen legend would have been 80 this year, and his voice still gives us chills. What's your ultimate Freddie moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolutions
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped and changed the game. Considered a pivotal album, it showed their incredible artistic growth. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?
